actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 28 (4d8+5) piercing damage. If this attack hits a frightened creature, the nalfeshnee regains HP equal to half the damage dealt.

actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 21 (3d10+5) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 STR save or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Gore

actions.desc: The nalfeshnee makes one Bite attack, one Gore attack, and two Claw attacks.
actions.desc_ru: Действие «Мултиаттак»; тип: action. Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).
actions.name: Multiattack

actions.desc: When a creature the nalfeshnee can see within 20 feet of it is reduced to 0 HP or dies, the nalfeshnee can move up to its speed toward the creature without provoking opportunity attacks then feast on the creature, if it moves to within 5 feet of the creature. The nalfeshnee regains HP equal to twice the creature's CR or class level, and the creature has disadvantage on the next death save it makes, if it is making death saves.
actions.desc_ru: Действие «Судден Феаст»; тип: reaction. Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).
actions.name: Sudden Feast

actions.desc: The nalfeshnee magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.
actions.desc_ru: Действие «Телепорт»; тип: bonus_action. Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).
actions.name: Teleport

traits.desc: The nalfeshnee is resistant to cold, fire, and lightning damage. In addition, it is immune to poison damage and to the poisoned condition.
traits.desc_ru: Особенность «Демоник Ресилиенке». Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).
traits.name: Demonic Resilience

traits.desc: The nalfeshnee magically emits scintillating, multicolored light that disorients and frightens mortals. Each creature that isn't an Aberration, Celestial, or Fiend and that starts its turn within 15 feet of the nalfeshnee must succeed on a DC 16 WIS save or be frightened until the start of its next turn. A creature that fails the save by 5 or more must take the Dash action on its turn and move away from the nalfeshnee by the safest available route, unless there is nowhere to move.
traits.desc_ru: Особенность «Хоррифик Нимбус». Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).
traits.name: Horrific Nimbus

traits.desc: The nalfeshnee has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
